summary: Moved the per-file stage/unstage button in the git ChangesPanel into the same row as the file entry and made it visible only on row hover/focus-within. Implementation split between the extension markup (icon-only button with aria-label/title preserved) and the host app's changes.css (grid layout with a hover-revealed action cell).
decisions: Stage/unstage button rendered as a compact icon-only button (+/−) rather than text + icon, so it fits inline on the file row; aria-label and title keep the accessible name 'Stage file' / 'Unstage file' (switching to 'Staging…' / 'Unstaging…' while updating).

Layout uses a two-column CSS grid on [data-ui='change-file'] (header | actions) with the action cell hidden via visibility and revealed on :hover/:focus-within of the row, so nothing shifts when it appears.
Diff body ([data-ui='change-body']) is spanned across both grid columns so it stays full-width below the row.
Hover-only styling lives in the host app's changes.css (matching where all other change-* styles live); a host that doesn't include this CSS will not get the hover-reveal behavior.
errors: First edit attempt to ChangesPanel.svelte failed with 'edits[0] and edits[1] overlap'; retried by merging into a single edit block, which succeeded.
